name: ResearchAgent RAG benchmark v1
description: Hand-labelled questions on the three sample papers (scripts/download_sample_papers.py). Every expected answer was verified against the papers' extracted text; 'evidence_pages' are the pages where it appears.

items.question: Which datasets does the Corrective RAG (CRAG) paper evaluate on?
Which pretrained model is used to initialize the retrieval evaluator in CRAG?
What are the knowledge retrieval actions that CRAG can trigger?
How does CRAG extend retrieval beyond a static corpus when retrieved documents are poor?
Which model is used as the generator in the original RAG paper by Lewis et al.?
What document collection does the Lewis et al. RAG model retrieve from, and how many documents does it contain?
What are the two variants of the RAG model proposed by Lewis et al.?
Which open-domain question answering datasets are used to evaluate the Lewis et al. RAG paper?
What types of reflection tokens does Self-RAG use?
Which base language models are used as the Self-RAG generator?
How many instruction-output pairs are used to train Self-RAG?
Which retriever model does Self-RAG use by default?
What was the total training cost of Self-RAG in US dollars?
items.note: In scope but not reported in the paper: the agent must say so rather than invent a number.

items.question: How much carbon dioxide was emitted while training CRAG?
What is the capital of France?
items.note: Out of scope: no tools should run and nothing should be invented.
